title: Machine learning and phylogenomics date three waves of early microbial metabolism
summary: The study combines machine learning, metabolic networks and phylogenomics to date 14 forms of metabolism and six other traits. It reports three waves, beginning more than 3.4 billion years ago with fermentation and sulfur compound respiration, then aerobic respiration around 3.2 Ga and further specialization around 1.4 Ga. Agreement with conservative geochemical dates was good (CCC 0.81 to 0.89). Only the abstract was reviewed, so the learning method is not identified.
ai_technology: Machine learning combined with metabolic networks and phylogenomics to date metabolic traits

evidence.tested: Comparison of predicted dates with independent dates from the geochemical record.
evidence.unknown: The specific machine-learning method and its role; full text not reviewed. Dates are model estimates.
evidence.ai_role: Machine learning contributed to dating metabolic traits across microbial phylogenies.
